name: Aisha Rahman
bio: Met during freshman orientation. She's a product designer in Toronto now. We bond over bad reality TV and good coffee.

name: Marcus Webb
bio: Former colleague turned close friend. We used to grab lunch every Friday. Now we catch up over weekly runs.

name: Priya Nair
bio: Grew up two houses down from each other. She moved to Bangalore for her MBA and we've been terrible at keeping in touch.

name: Jordan Ellis
bio: Backpacked through Southeast Asia together after graduation. Jordan is a freelance photographer based in Lisbon.

name: Sofia Mendes
bio: Met at a local book club three years ago. We grab brunch almost every other weekend and share a reading list.

name: Daniel Okafor
bio: Best friends throughout high school. He's a civil engineer in Lagos now. Life got busy but the bond never faded.

name: Lily Chen
bio: My first engineering manager who became a genuine friend. She's now a VP at a startup in Singapore and gives the best career advice.

name: Tariq Hassan
bio: My college roommate for three years. We used to argue about dishes and now laugh about it on monthly video calls.

name: Nina Kovacs
bio: Met at an art workshop in Budapest. She's a sculptor and illustrator. We collaborate on small creative projects online.

name: Ryan Gallagher
bio: Played football together all through high school. He coaches youth soccer in Dublin now. We trade voice notes more than texts.
